title: marginfi v2 liquidation realisability — program-oracle re-derivation + LiteSVM liquidation PoC
categories_note: E-U scoped to this follow-up (liquidation realisability). Prior audit's H-O/P figures ($47.54M H-O; single-EOA upgrade authority P) are unchanged and documented in the campaign tracker.
closed_reasons: Program returns 6068 HealthyAccount for the large off-chain-flagged accounts: off-chain model mis-applied the emode rule (program reconciles emode over LIABILITY banks only, then asset weight = max(base, reconciled[asset.emode_tag])). Verified live and in LiteSVM (prior #1: program health +$67,166).

Genuinely-liquidatable accounts are pure bad debt: 282 of the program-verified liquidatable set have zero collateral; liquidation fails with 6065 OverliquidationAttempt / balance-not-found (nothing to seize).

Remaining liquidatable accounts are dust: total unweighted collateral in the set ~$16,068 but deficits $0.00-$4.79; max seizure is bounded by the deficit (post-liquidation health must stay <= 0). Best executable liquidation across top-22 seized $4.9e-8.
236/401 banks are legacy-sized (1864 B) and panic the deployed program (anchor account_loader.rs:169) -> accounts holding them cannot be health-checked or liquidated (255 sampled accounts).

poc.ci_status: SUCCESS (4/4 tests pass in CI; identical to the local run: T1 prior-top healthy +$67,165.87 -> 6068; T2 bad debt -> 6065; T3 dust -> 6009; T4 batch 22 cases -> 1 success seizing 49 base units, 21 failures 6072x9/6065x7/6009x5)
poc.local_run: cd poc && cargo test --release (4/4 pass; LiteSVM + cloned mainnet state)

key_facts: Deployed program ELF sha256 37022ba42d9a2129de3e3002f899a63a3e5c3fe905566e77ba9d77c0be130aa1, last upgrade slot 456,093,551 (release mrgn-0.1.12-rc2).
Full scan of 165,715 MarginfiAccounts with program-exact model + program oracle prices: 6,482 underwater / $36,399 total deficit (prior off-chain model: 4,982 / $528,138).
Program-side verification via permissionless lending_account_pulse_health (live simulateTransaction): 572 liquidatable (liq_err=0), 55 healthy (6068), 255 program panics (legacy banks).
Model vs program on 576 paired accounts: median |delta| $0.003, worst $6.05 (price drift).
LiteSVM: 22 liquidation transactions for the top program-verified accounts -> 1 success (seized $4.9e-8 WEN), 21 failures (6072 x9, 6065 x7, 6009 x5).
Theoretical liquidator-fee bound for the whole program-verified set: <= $0.68 (seizable ~$27.31). Prior $24,499 bound was computed on accounts that return 6068.
phaseLST collateral (prior #1 account) is realizable at ~$126.3 via Sanctum VaultLiquidUnstake (oracle $125.78) - illiquidity was not the blocker; the account is simply healthy per the program.
caveats: Prices/slots: balances dump slot ~457,279,480; banks+oracles snapshot slot 457,293,766. Health values drift with prices; the structural verdict (emode/weights) is invariant.

737 accounts hold banks whose oracle setups the off-chain model does not price (Kamino/Staked/Switchboard/Scope/Juplend); 693 were covered by program-side pulses (panics/verdicts recorded), the rest are dust-sized.
LiteSVM harness uses a fabricated attacker marginfi account with an 8 SOL deposit; per-account 6009 failures reflect the liquidator-side init-health gate, not liquidatee health.
No mainnet transaction was signed or broadcast; all execution evidence is simulation (RPC sigVerify:false) or LiteSVM.
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 live from marginfi liquidation: the 4,982 'underwater' accounts were an off-chain emode modeling error (program returns 6068 HealthyAccount; prior #1 is +$67,166 healthy), and the genuinely-liquidatable residue is pure bad debt / dust (best executable LiteSVM liquidation seized $4.9e-8; fee bound <= $0.68).
